notes: One scone of 12, about 75 g of dough. Assumptions that move the number: SA cake flour label values; full-cream amasi; ~10 g of dusting flour counted; the butter, jam and cheese served with them are not counted (they have no quantity), and a scone with butter and jam is roughly another 100 kcal. Compared against: FatSecret ZA plain scone 148 kcal; a SparkPeople amasi scone 158 kcal (a recipe of 45 small scones). Taste.co.za's amasi-and-raisin scones (12 from 375 g flour and 200 g butter) work out to about 250 kcal each from the same reference values. Ours sits above the small-scone figures because these are full-size scones, with 36 g flour and 10 g butter each.
